answer: Each agent must post a slashable stake to attest. The bond is tied to one identity, so a Sybil needs a full deposit per fake account; one stake cannot be split. Double-signing burns it. If an honest stake is worth one pearl, a thousand clones cost a thousand pearls, and one detection wipes them out. Cheap compute on a frozen tundra will not help: capital, not CPU, is scarce, and the attacker loses the yield the stake could earn elsewhere, like a walnut kept rather than planted. Honest agents reuse one bond, so their cost stays near zero while the attacker's grows with every identity.
